grade_rationale: 4 P1 findings (3 critical CVEs + 1 broken endpoint) exceed the C-grade ceiling of max_p1=2. 11 P2 findings are within D range.

findings.title: GET /api/search route not wired — FR-dependency-search unimplemented
findings.description: FR-dependency-search requires a GET /api/search?q= cross-entity typeahead endpoint. No route file exists and app.ts never registers it. Test file explicitly disclaims all 4 tests will FAIL. DependencyPicker modal is silently broken in production.
findings.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts implementing GET /api/search?q=. Wire into app.ts. Add // Verifies: FR-dependency-search.

findings.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
findings.description: Arbitrary code execution via crafted protobuf definitions. RCE possible if untrusted protobuf data is processed.
findings.recommendation: npm update protobufjs in platform/orchestrator and portal/Backend.

findings.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection (CVSS 9.8)
findings.description: 7 CVEs enabling JavaScript injection via AST type confusion in handlebars templates. Exploitable if any route renders user-supplied data via handlebars.
findings.recommendation: Update to handlebars 4.7.9+ in all workspaces.

findings.title: Vitest Arbitrary File Read / Code Execution
findings.description: When Vitest UI server is running, arbitrary files can be read and code executed. Risk applies to CI/CD environments running vitest --ui.
findings.recommendation: npm update vitest in portal/* workspaces. Disable --ui flag in CI/CD pipeline.

findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to portal/ codebase
findings.description: Enforcer scans only Source/ and E2E/. Portal plans (~100+ FRs) are never verified. Verification gate is a no-op for the entire portal codebase.
findings.recommendation: Add portal/Backend and portal/Frontend to source.dirs in inspector.config.yml. Update traceability-enforcer.py to scope FR extraction to table rows.

findings.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
findings.description: Two test files per page: tests/ (root) and tests/pages/. Overlapping descriptions, different mock setups. CI runs both, causing confusion and maintenance overhead.
findings.recommendation: Remove root-level tests/WorkItemDetailPage.test.tsx and tests/WorkItemListPage.test.tsx. Keep tests/pages/ variants as canonical.

findings.title: Dual logger implementations; no dev pretty-printing (FR-003 deviation)
findings.description: Two logger files (logger.ts shim + utils/logger.ts). Neither checks NODE_ENV. JSON always emitted. Shim silently drops context keys when msg is missing.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to single logger in src/utils/logger.ts with NODE_ENV detection. Remove src/logger.ts shim.

findings.title: DebugPortalPage has no valid FR traceability — unspecified feature
findings.description: File carries a non-FR traceability comment. No spec entry in Specifications/workflow-engine.md. Ships to production without a requirement.
findings.recommendation: Either add FR-WF-014 spec entry, or guard route with import.meta.env.DEV.

findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection (CVSS 7.5)
findings.description: HTTP header injection via CRLF characters in multipart form-data boundaries. All workspaces affected.
findings.recommendation: npm update form-data across all workspaces.

findings.title: Vite SSRF-like vulnerability (CVSS 5.3)
findings.description: Vite dev server can be used to proxy arbitrary internal hosts. Risk in development and CI environments.
findings.recommendation: npm update vite to 8.x.

findings.title: PostCSS XSS via unescaped style tag injection (CVSS 6.1)
findings.description: PostCSS fails to escape certain CSS values, enabling XSS via injected style tags in build output.
findings.recommendation: npm update postcss.

findings.title: React Router Open Redirect (GHSA-2j2x-hqr9-3h42)
findings.description: react-router-dom 6.26.0 allows open redirect via protocol-relative URLs. Any user can be redirected to an attacker-controlled domain.
findings.recommendation: npm update react-router-dom to 6.30.4+.

findings.title: @opentelemetry multiple high-severity CVEs
findings.description: Multiple high-severity CVEs in @opentelemetry packages in portal workspaces.
findings.recommendation: npm update @opentelemetry/* in portal workspaces.

findings.title: @grpc/grpc-js multiple high-severity CVEs
findings.description: Multiple high-severity CVEs in @grpc/grpc-js affecting gRPC communication layer.
findings.recommendation: npm update @grpc/grpc-js.

findings.title: path-to-regexp multiple high-severity CVEs
findings.description: Multiple high-severity CVEs in path-to-regexp, a transitive dependency of Express.
findings.recommendation: npm update path-to-regexp (or update express which pins it).

findings.title: Backend uses Jest; CLAUDE.md mandates Vitest for both layers
findings.description: Backend uses Jest 29 with ts-jest. --forceExit flag suggests open-handle problem. CLAUDE.md mandates Vitest.
findings.recommendation: Migrate Source/Backend from Jest to Vitest. Investigate --forceExit root cause first.

findings.title: OpenTelemetry spans absent — architecture rule violated
findings.description: No @opentelemetry imports anywhere in Source/Backend/src/. No spans on critical workflow endpoints. No traceparent propagation.
findings.recommendation: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node + auto-instrumentations. Add custom spans for route, assess, dispatch actions.

findings.title: eslint-disable suppresses react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in 2 production files
findings.description: useWorkItems.ts manually enumerates filter keys in useEffect deps; adding a new filter field will silently fail. DependencyPicker.tsx can use useMemo instead.
findings.recommendation: Fix the underlying deps issues rather than suppressing the lint rule.

findings.title: Traceability enforcer extracts FR IDs from prose, causing 7 false failures
findings.description: Global regex FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ extracts IDs from seed data prose and cross-references, not just requirement table rows. Produces 7 phantom failures on dependency-linking plan.
findings.recommendation: Narrow regex to table rows: r'^\|\s*(FR-[A-Z0-9-]+)\s*\|' with MULTILINE flag.

findings.title: express 4.18.2 is 1 major version behind (latest 5.2.1)
findings.recommendation: npm update express to 4.22.2 (patch); plan major migration to 5.x next sprint.

findings.title: pino 8.17.0 is 2 major versions behind (latest 10.3.1)
findings.recommendation: npm update pino to latest 8.x patch; plan upgrade to 10.x.

findings.title: uuid 9.0.0 is 5 major versions behind (latest 14.0.1)
findings.recommendation: Plan migration to uuid 14.x.

findings.title: react/react-dom 18.3.1 is 1 major behind (latest 19.2.7)
findings.recommendation: Plan migration to React 19 (breaking changes — coordinate across frontend).

findings.title: vite 5.4.0 is 2 major versions behind (latest 8.1.4)
findings.recommendation: npm update vite to latest 5.x patch first; plan major upgrade to 8.x.

findings.title: VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS comment overstates pending_dependencies support
findings.description: Comment implies pending_dependencies is a valid status. It is not in the WorkItemStatus enum. Misleads maintainers.
findings.recommendation: Update comment to accurately describe the 400-error blocking behaviour.

findings.title: E2E npm test script is a placeholder (exits 1)
findings.description: npm test --workspaces --if-present will fail at E2E workspace. Playwright config exists but npm test is not wired.
findings.recommendation: Update test script to 'playwright test' or remove workspace from root workspaces config.

findings.title: portal/Backend has 577 total dependencies — exceeds safe threshold
findings.description: 397 production deps in portal/Backend. 54 total CVEs. Supply chain attack surface is large.
findings.recommendation: Audit and remove unused dependencies. Target < 200 production deps.

escalations.title: Vitest Arbitrary File Read / Code Execution

cross_reference_map.root_cause: npm dependencies not updated and no CI audit gates
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: 5 findings resolved by: adding npm audit --audit-level=critical to CI + running npm update across all workspaces
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Add npm audit gate to CI pipeline; run npm update in all workspaces immediately

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Traceability enforcer scope and regex limitations
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: Both findings resolved by single update to tools/traceability-enforcer.py
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Add portal/ to scanned dirs; narrow FR extraction regex to table rows only

cross_reference_map.root_cause: Test infrastructure fragmentation from incremental migration
cross_reference_map.fix_impact: 2 findings resolved by: deleting duplicate test files + migrating backend from Jest to Vitest
cross_reference_map.single_fix: Clean up duplicate test files; complete Vitest migration for backend
